span.normalized: These LTAs cover sales of ATI’s specialty materials, precision forgings, components, and machined parts that are used in both next-generation and legacy aircraft platforms, including jet engines. Our LTAs include a titanium products supply agreement for aircraft airframes and structural components with Boeing. This LTA covers value-added titanium products and provides opportunities for greater use of ATI’s next generation and advanced titanium alloys in both long product and flat-rolled product forms.
